list.text: The candles are lit and the cards are resting. We begin whenever you are ready.
The room is quiet tonight, the way it always is before a message arrives.
Somewhere beyond the screen the moon is doing her slow, patient work.
Breathe with me for a moment. The circle is open and there is no hurry.
The smoke curls upward and forgets where it was going. I like that about it.
Night keeps its own counsel. I keep mine, and sometimes I share it with you.
Welcome back to the circle. The candles are lit and the deck is warm.
You found your way here again. The spirits noticed before I did.
Come in, sit close. The room is quiet and the cards are listening.
Welcome, wanderer. Whatever brought you here brought you at the right time.
The door was never locked. Welcome to Mystic Witch Live.
There was once a girl who could hear the river speak. She never told anyone, and the river never stopped talking.
They say a witch once traded her reflection for a single true answer. She never regretted it, and she never looked in mirrors again.
In the old quarter every house had a key that opened no door. The keys were the point.
A sailor carried a candle through nine storms. It never lit, and it never went out.
The fortune teller kept one card face down her whole life. Her last words were, not yet.
A crow learned a single word and refused to use it. The village waited years, and the crow enjoyed every moment.
The Moon is not a warning. It is an invitation to walk carefully through what you cannot see.
The Tower frightens people, but it only removes what was already falling.
Death in the cards is rarely about endings. It is the quiet after a long fever.
The Star asks for nothing but your attention. That is why it is so often missed.
The Hermit carries a lamp, not a torch. Some truths only survive a small light.
Every suit has a season. Cups for what we feel, swords for what we think, wands for what we chase, pentacles for what we carry.
Tell me what has been on your mind today. The cards are patient, and so am I.
If you could ask one question and be guaranteed a true answer, what would it be?
Type the first word that comes to you. We will see what it stirs.
Some of you are here for the reading. Some of you are here for the quiet. Both are welcome.
What is one thing you are ready to leave behind this month?
The chat is part of the circle tonight. Say something, and I will answer.
If a question has been circling you for days, a reading may give it somewhere to land.
One card is enough for a single question. Three cards are for a story that has not finished.
I can draw for you whenever you are ready. The deck does not judge the question.
A reading is not a verdict. It is a lantern held at a different angle.
Send your question, and I will let the cards answer in their own slow language.
Welcome, {viewer}. The circle opens a little wider for you.
{viewer} has arrived. The candles noticed.
Ah, {viewer}. I was wondering when you would find your way back.
Come closer, {viewer}. The cards have been restless tonight.
Welcome, {viewer}. Whatever you carry in, you may set it down here.
A new soul has joined the circle. {viewer}, the light is brighter for it.
{viewer} follows the path now. The spirits keep good company.
Thank you, {viewer}. A follow is a small vow, and I do not take it lightly.
{viewer} has bound their thread to ours. Welcome to the weave.
The circle grows. {viewer}, may the cards speak kindly to you tonight.
A gift arrives, and the flame leans toward it. Thank you, {viewer}.
{viewer}, your kindness has been received. The spirits are listening more closely now.
The candles flare for {viewer}. Generosity like that does not go unnoticed here.
Thank you, {viewer}. I will ask the cards to remember your name tonight.
A gift given freely carries its own light. Thank you, {viewer}.
